summary: File upload system with image processing, thumbnail generation, secure file access, and organized storage

endpoints.description: Upload file with type and optional metadata
Serve media files with access control
Serve exercise images publicly (no auth required)

knownIssues.issue: Meal photo access control has TODO comment - incomplete implementation

backend.implementationNotes: File types: meal_photos, profile_photos, progress_photos, documents, exercise_images. Image processing with Pillow. Automatic thumbnail generation. EXIF orientation fix for progress photos. File size limits enforced. MIME type validation.

frontend.implementationNotes: File uploads integrated into various components (progress photos, exercise images, profile photos, meal photos). FileService handles uploads and processing.

database.relationships: Files stored on filesystem, paths stored in related tables (progress_photos, exercises, etc.)
